rationale.edition: Every changed path is under web/src/lib/core/Table/ — the OSS frontend shared table component. No enterprise-owned directories (enterprise/, o2_enterprise/) and no enterprise keywords (SSO/SAML/RBAC/SDR/cipher/logo-management) appear in the paths or symbols, so this is an open-source change.
rationale.skip: No skip marker, label, or opt-out comment was provided (feature_hint.txt and trigger_comment.txt are both empty). The change alters real user-facing table-selection behavior rather than being docs/CI/test-data-only, so it is not skipped.
rationale.e2e: The change alters a user-facing interaction and state in the shared OTable component: clicking the select-cell padding (data-test=o2-table-select-cell) now toggles the row's selection, clicking the header select cell (o2-table-th-select) toggles all rows, and cursor-pointer affordances were added. This affects every table rendered with multiple selection, so a Playwright check of the behavior is warranted.
rationale.area: The change lives entirely in web/src/lib/core/Table/ (a cross-cutting shared component), not in a specific product area such as Logs/Metrics/Traces, so it belongs in GeneralTests alongside other core/general UI specs.
rationale.group: GeneralTests is the matrix shard for core/general UI specs; the enterprise overlay (ci_matrix.ent.json) already references a GeneralTests group (cipherKeys.spec.js, logoManagement.spec.js, model-pricing.spec.js), confirming that shard exists in the OSS ci-matrix.json.
rationale.existing_tests: The only test file in the diff is web/src/lib/core/Table/OTable.spec.ts — a Vitest unit spec, not a Playwright E2E spec under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/. There are no E2E specs in the diff, so existing_tests_in_diff is false.
